title: Bound on reindexed witness coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $P,J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. Reindex the coordinates outside $P$ by their positions in a set of size equal to the number of coordinates outside $P$, and select those whose original indices lie in $J$. The number selected is at most $|J|$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ and $J$ are subsets of the $n$ coordinate indices
